name: Mango Pre-Roll | 1g
description: Our Hy-R Mango pre-roll is where vibrant color meets extraordinary taste. This Mango flavor dives deep into sweet, juicy, candy territory, bursting with watery sweetness in every puff. With flavors of stone fruit and candy, it delivers a massively flavorful experience. Enjoy the relaxed and peaceful effects, perfect for making any occasion feel more exotic.
